Egg number mainly depends on age and ovarian reserve, while egg quality reflects the genetic and metabolic health of the egg. Although new eggs cannot be created, the quality of existing eggs can be improved by optimizing the body’s internal environment.

A healthy lifestyle forms the foundation of good egg health. A balanced diet rich in proteins, antioxidants, fruits, vegetables, nuts, and healthy fats helps reduce oxidative stress on eggs. Maintaining an ideal body weight, avoiding smoking, alcohol, and excess caffeine, and ensuring adequate sleep are equally important. Stress reduction through yoga, meditation, or regular physical activity supports hormonal balance.

Medical optimization also plays a key role. Treating thyroid disorders, insulin resistance, and hormonal imbalances improves ovulation and ovarian response. Supplements such as CoQ10, myo-inositol, vitamin D, and omega-3 fatty acids may enhance egg quality when taken under medical supervision.

In IVF, individualized stimulation protocols, correct dosing, and precise timing can improve the number of mature eggs retrieved. Ultimately, improving egg quality and number is a gradual process, and early, personalized fertility care offers the best chance of success.
How to Improve Endometrial Thickness:

For pregnancy to occur, the uterus needs a healthy inner lining called the endometrium, where the embryo attaches and grows. In some women, this lining remains thin despite medicines, hormones, or fertility treatments. A thin endometrium can reduce the chances of embryo implantation, especially during IVF.

Mesenchymal Stem Cells (MSCs) are an advanced treatment option for women who do not respond to routine therapies. These special cells have the ability to repair and regenerate damaged tissues. They are usually obtained from safe sources such as the placenta or umbilical cord.

When MSCs are introduced into the uterus, they help improve blood flow, reduce scarring, and promote the growth of healthy endometrial tissue. Unlike treatments that work temporarily, MSC therapy aims to improve the overall quality of the uterine lining.

This therapy may benefit women with very thin endometrium, scarring after infections or surgery, or repeated IVF failures due to poor endometrial growth. MSC therapy is considered a specialized option and is recommended only after proper evaluation and counseling by a fertility specialist.

they were the steady compass when we were losing direction.
We believe more aspiring parents — especially those who have waited for years and almost given up — deserve to know that such doctors exist. That there are still healers who combine science with soul.

featured_reviews.name: pranali shirke
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was my first pregnancy, so after doing some research I wanted to register at a good nearby maternity hospital. While searching on Google, Lotus Multispeciality Hospital was suggested as the best nearby hospital. I read the reviews, consulted Dr. Megha Ma’am, and decided to register there.

The entire nursing staff and the attendants (mavashis) were very supportive. Ma’am herself was very helpful and supportive. Throughout the pregnancy I received excellent guidance, and luckily I delivered a healthy baby through a normal delivery.

Even after the pregnancy, I received a lot of support also last but not the least my thanks to Dr. Roshan too.
I would recommend this hospital to everyone for maternity care.

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Dewlekar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a wonderful experience at Lotus Multispeciality Hospital during the delivery of our baby. Dr. Megha Anaje was extremely supportive, knowledgeable, and caring throughout the entire journey. She guided us with patience, confidence, and compassion, which gave our family a lot of comfort during such an important time.
The nursing staff and hospital team were also excellent — very attentive, polite, and always ready to help whenever needed. The cleanliness, care, and overall management of the hospital were truly commendable.
We are sincerely grateful to Dr. Megha Anaje and the entire Lotus Mutli speciality Hospital staff for making this experience smooth, safe, and memorable for our family. Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality maternity care.

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Hatle
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a great experience at Lotus Hospital for my baby’s delivery. Dr. Megha is an excellent doctor—calm, skilled, and very reassuring. The nurses and staff are equally supportive and cooperative. The hospital is clean, hygienic, and well-organized. I really appreciated the thoughtful extras like the First Cry baby hamper, a family photoshoot with an album, and the detailed file with advance medication guidance, diet, and exercise plans, which made the whole process much smoother and stress-free.

The rooms are spacious, with comfortable sofas for family members, and the washrooms are well-maintained. My C-section was well planned and almost painless, making the overall experience very positive. The only area for improvement would be the taste of the hospital food. Overall, I would definitely recommend Dr. Megha and Lotus Hospital for delivery.

featured_reviews.name: Pranali Mistry
featured_reviews.review_text:
I went under Uterus Removal surgery through Laparoscopy under Dr. Megha Anaje. I must say she is a fabulous Dr & highly good at her skills. The complete experience was very smooth & painless. Hospital staff, Nurses were also good & prompt. Recovery is also good
Thank You Dr for your support

featured_reviews.name: Ritesh Poojari
featured_reviews.review_text:
We chose this doctor and hospital based on the positive Google reviews. We visited the hospital with the happiness of a positive pregnancy, but due to an unexpected medical complication, immediate attention and surgery were required. Dr. Megha Anaje quickly identified the issue through prompt tests and treated it as an emergency without any delay. Her timely decision truly made a big difference for us.

She patiently explained the situation and the planned procedure, which gave us clarity and confidence during a very difficult time. The surgery was performed by Dr. Megha Anaje along with Dr. Haresh Vaghasiya. After the procedure, they clearly explained everything and answered all our questions, even showing pictures to help us understand better. Dr. Vaghasiya especially gave us enough time to clarify our doubts and answered all our questions patiently.

I truly appreciated the way the nurses and attendants (maushi) took good care of my wife. They were polite and responsive whenever we called. The other staff members, including receptionists and lab technicians, were also very kind and supportive.

One of the biggest advantages is their in-house diagnostic facility, which made all the required tests quick and hassle-free, especially during an emergency.

We are sincerely grateful to the entire team for their expertise and compassionate care.

featured_reviews.name: Dakshata Jadhav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dr. Megha Anaje is an experienced and skilled gynaecologist and obstetrician. She understands whether our problems are something to really worry about or normal. I had searched several hospitals before registering myself into Lotus and  I feel glad that I registered here. I was admitted at 6 pm and delivered a baby in about an hour as normal. She really guided me in the entire labour process and was very kind and gentle throughout my labour. The post delivery was also taken care of very nicely and I had no issues or severe pains later.

The staff:
The staff is exceptionally great and cooperative. The nurses and help staff, actually the entire hospital staff itself is great. No delays observed, concerns very well taken care of, I want to exceptionally thank all the skilled nurses for being so patient and gentle with their patients. I can name a few whose name I remember but that would be unfair for rest of the nurses. Hence, thank you each and every nurse and staff folks who made my experience better at hospital.

featured_reviews.name: Brijesh yadav
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent hospital with professional staff and quick service. Doctors are knowledgeable and supportive. Clean environment, polite nurses, and smooth process from admission to discharge. Highly recommended

featured_reviews.name: Ruchita Raut
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had decided almost 10 years ago that I would deliver my baby at Lotus Hospital with Dr. Megha Anaje, and I am happy that I followed the same decision. My sister-in-law had delivered her first child under the guidance of Dr. Megha and had a normal delivery, which also gave me confidence in choosing her.

Throughout my pregnancy journey, Dr. Megha gave me very helpful advice that supported a normal delivery. She always makes her patients feel comfortable and provides proper guidance without scaring them.

I am very happy that I chose to deliver my baby with Dr. Megha. She is a very helpful, cooperative, and patient doctor.

My delivery was scheduled in the morning around 8 a.m., and Dr. Megha and paediatrician Dr. Roshan was available at that time, which made me feel very safe and confident.

Her entire team is also very cooperative and polite, including the attendant (mavshi), sisters and all the staff. Everyone was supportive and helped me with feeding and burping the baby.

All the best to Lotus Hospital, Dr. Megha, and the entire team.

I would definitely recommend this hospital to everyone.

featured_reviews.name: Nisha Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
Long Post Alert!

Women's Hospital "Room Harmony" has been etched in my memory as it  was my home for two and a half months.
I had a complicated pregnancy and was advised completed bed rest and was admitted under Dr. Gayatri Rao's guidance who turned my hope into reality. She is the sweetest soul who would brighten my dark days with her encouraging words and smile.
On April 2nd, I delivered a premature baby boy after the long tiring journey.
I would also like to thank the nurses who had made my stay homely with utmost care and positivity. They were nice to me and somehow became my friends by the time I was leaving.
A big shoutout to sisters - Vidya, Hema, Trishala, Smita, Mayuri, Namrata, Alpa, Yashika, Sunita and I might have missed few other names but I am equally grateful to each.

Not only the nurses even the maushis were accomodating everytime I had to use the loo as I was on complete bed rest.

Last but not the least, I would also love to mention few other doctors who helped me with the littlest difficulty, doubt, concern even during the middle of the night namely Dr. Dipali, Dr. Vijaya, Dr. Shalini, Dr. Surti and Dr. Dolly.

Dr. Dipali was very empathetic soul who would keep visiting my room and appreciating and encouraging me to overcome each day in the hospital. Dr. Vijaya would flawlessly put the IV drip's on me with most care and concern avoiding any chances of hurting me. Also, Dr. Manju sinha would keep visiting and advising me to read books for a positivity.

Another appreciation I would want to give the phlebotomist who would come for my blood tests and would tell me lovingly that I would be a good mom. I forgot her name but I hope you guys will find out who she is.

It was a tumultuous journey for both me and my husband, but the way Dr. Gayatri Rao made my pregnancy possible with her positive smile and golden words is beyond everything.

It was a long stay but it became bearable with each and every person mentioned above. Thank you guys, for helping me out during the most fragile yet memorable time of my life. I will always be indebted to this hospital.

The only drawback if I may mention are the charges of the hospital as it is located at the posh side of bandra khar. But, for middle class people like us the charges were indeed challenging.

featured_reviews.name: LaToyah Trindade
featured_reviews.review_text:
I can’t say enough about the incredible care I received at this women’s hospital. From the moment I arrived, the team of doctors, nurses, and staff made me feel completely at ease—so much so that I never once felt nervous. They created such a warm and comfortable environment, which is rare in a hospital setting.

One of the surprising highlights? The food! For a hospital, it was excellent—healthy, fresh, and honestly enjoyable. And the best part? I actually got rest after my surgery. Unlike most places, there were no banging doors or bright lights disturbing me all night. I woke up feeling well-rested and cared for.

Ladies, if you ever need surgery for your “woman bits,” this is the only place you should consider. You’ll feel supported, comfortable, and in the best hands possible.
